omp.note: `tested` is the list for omp-session-control and omp-services; omp-private-relay and omp-dashboard list theirs as `ompTested` under `plugins`. Only listed versions have been run. Newer versions are expected to work but are untested until listed.

bun.note: For running the tests only. omp 18.18.0 embeds Bun 1.4.4, which is what the extension runs on.

ompApi: ExtensionContext.mode, agent.kind, sessionManager.getSessionId, isIdle, abort, ui.notify

ompInternals.use: lookup('disabledExtensions').get and .listen with ExtensionAPI.pi.settings, to close control when the extension is disabled live
ompInternals.ifMissing: control still works, but a live disabledExtensions edit no longer closes the socket until the session ends or the off file is used; the extension reports this once when control starts and in /session-control status

ompInternals.use: getPluginSettings, to read the stored controlDir and idleTimeoutMs

omp-services.note: The command line also reads omp's cached marketplace catalog (<plugins root>/cache/marketplaces/<name>/marketplace.json), found from the installPath that `omp plugin list --json` reports.

omp-private-relay.runtime: The Bun embedded in omp (BUN_BE_BUN=1 <omp> <script>), 1.4.4 or newer: the relay refuses to start on an older one.
ompInterfaces: omp --version prints omp/<major.minor.patch> when BUN_BE_BUN is not set (init, doctor and rebuild-web read the minor from it)
BUN_BE_BUN=1 <omp> <file.ts> runs the file on omp's embedded Bun
omp config get|set collab.relayUrl and collab.webUrl (init shows the exact lines and runs them only on consent)
The Collab room contract of omp's stand-in relay: GET /r/<roomId>?role=host|guest, envelope peer ids, close codes 4001, 4004, 4009, 4029
Collab links: <web url>/#<relay url>/r/<roomId>.<key>; a loopback ws:// relay in a link is rewritten by the patched web client
collab-web at the release tag (packages/collab-web: index.html, src/lib/link.ts, src/lib/socket.ts), changed by patches/collab-web-<minor>.patch
omp-private-relay.note: The patch applies unchanged to v18.18.0 and v18.18.3; the pinned build is from v18.18.3. A new omp minor needs its own patch file and build.

ompInterfaces: omp collab list --json and omp collab link <instanceId> [--view] --json, JSON version 1
omp config get collab.displayName, collab.relayUrl and collab.webUrl
omp-dashboard.note: The dashboard page is committed in ui-dist and pinned by ui-build.json (SHA-256 per file); it needs no network.
